Rename a provider, enable or disable it, or connect, change or disconnect a payment source's
endpoint and its test endpoint and rotate their signing secrets.

Disabling, disconnecting and rotating ask first; --yes skips that. A new signing secret is shown
once: with --json or --quiet it goes to standard error. 'voidhash provider connect' changes a
store's credentials.

Usage:
  voidhash provider edit [provider] [flags]

Arguments:
  provider  The provider: app-store, google-play, stripe, a payment source's slug or name, or its id

Flags:
      --disable                   Stop processing its purchases
      --disconnect-endpoint       Stop calling a payment source's endpoint
      --disconnect-test-endpoint  Stop calling a payment source's test endpoint; test requests go to
                                  its endpoint
      --enable                    Process its purchases again; a store's credentials are checked
      --endpoint <url>            A payment source's HTTPS endpoint url, its server's provider
                                  handler; it serves production requests, and test ones without a
                                  test endpoint
  -h, --help                      Show help for this command
      --json                      Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>               Its new name
      --project <project>         Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                  (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                     Print only ids, one per line
      --rotate-secret             Give a payment source's endpoint a new signing secret
      --rotate-test-secret        Give a payment source's test endpoint a new signing secret
      --test-endpoint <url>       A payment source's HTTPS endpoint url for test requests only, such
                                  as its staging server's provider handler
  -y, --yes                       Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider edit stripe --disable
  voidhash provider edit paddle --endpoint https://pay.example.com/voidhash
  voidhash provider edit paddle --rotate-secret --yes
